_comment: Shown in the update prompts. Edit before each release. minVersion: apps older than this must update before they continue (use for security fixes); leave it at an old version normally.
notes: New: course outlines. On any course, open Outline and upload the PDF (or photos): topics, marks, grading, exam dates and office hours fill in
Tick off course topics as classes cover them; send exam dates to your Exams planner and the mark distribution to the Marks estimator
Completed courses now list every finished semester, including your first; add a semester's courses and grades yourself if they aren't synced
Club pages: titles with their action beside them, number tiles in one row, check-in scanner beside the manual panel
